title: A Claude session on the Windows host records a run of the test suite
goal: kb/_self/reports/windows-run.md records the commit, the host and the result of python3 _tools/tests.py as run by a Claude session on the Windows host, within the Windows ceiling of _tools/tests_ceiling.json, and the record names a commit that is an ancestor of HEAD

run: import re,subprocess,sys,pathlib;t=pathlib.Path('kb/_self/reports/windows-run.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8');c=re.search(r'\b[0-9a-f]{9,40}\b',t).group(0);sys.exit(subprocess.run(['git','merge-base','--is-ancestor',c,'HEAD']).returncode or int('tests.py' not in t))

gates.question: tests.py on the Windows host passed 54/54 in 88 s quiet (136 s with a worker running), over the win32 ceiling of 60 s (D-7zbgyagn): raise win32 max_seconds in _tools/tests_ceiling.json to which value? darwin 20, linux 60, ids 100 and files 15 stay.

trigger.when: a Claude session runs in a clone on the Windows host and can run tests.py and stress_test.py there

notes: Its run needs a Claude session in a clone on the Windows host; the trigger holds it until one exists (fire it with backlog.py fire ST-pg5jyebo), and the same session can run ST-xjb4wykm “Defender's cost on test scratch files is measured and settled by the operator”. Housekeeping 2026-10-06: the stress suite is gone, so the record covers tests.py only; the -k windows_run_record test became a check that reads the record's commit and asks git whether it is an ancestor of HEAD (a doc-reading test is not written). The trigger's text still names stress_test.py: backlog.py has no command to reword a trigger.
